title: Written semantic mention extraction output, v2
description: v2 carries only what the candidate pipeline consumes. evidence_fields, lookup_queries and relation_hypotheses are removed: nothing reads relation_hypotheses, evidence_fields is reconstructible from validated source references, and lookup_queries are generated deterministically after extraction. Measured against Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B at c202236235762e1c871ad0ccb60c8ee5ba337b9a, that removal takes the per-item scaffolding floor from 616 tokens to 274 and brings a 256-character Han or Hangul item from 5,271 tokens to 1,984, which fits the 2,986-token singleton ceiling. It does not fix emoji, rare kana or combining marks, which still overflow at maxLength 256 and require the tested overflow route rather than a schema change.

items.description: Two, not four. The gateway accepts at most two indexed items and the contract calibrates for two; the schema is set to the same number so a third cannot be emitted by a model that misread its instructions. Raising it is a schema version change, which is correct: batch size is part of the output contract, not a runtime dial.

status.description: extracted or abstained. An explicit status rather than a bare boolean, so an infrastructure failure can never be recorded as a semantic abstention: a timeout has no status here at all and is recorded by the caller.

allOf.description: An extracted item has at least one mention and no reason. Executable rather than documented: the pair (status, mentions, abstain_reason) can otherwise disagree three ways.
A semantic abstention has no mentions and states why.

surface.description: Kept alongside the offsets during the first evaluation so the gateway can check surface == source[start:end]. One of the two may be dropped later if multilingual offset accuracy proves reliable; they must not both remain permanently without an accuracy reason.

source_field_index.description: Required for tags, null otherwise. Enforced by the allOf below rather than left to a caller.

start.description: Unicode code point offset, not a byte or UTF-16 offset. A surrogate-pair or combining-mark string makes the three disagree, and the gateway's equality check is what would fail.

family_hypothesis.description: music_recording is deliberately absent. 0221 removed recordings from the versioned ontology because identity is not vocabulary; a model emitting that family would reopen the minting route it closed.
